dataset.name: Primary lower-grade diffuse glioma (GLASS, 2022)
dataset.description: GLASS diffuse-glioma cohort restricted to non-TCGA primary grade II-III tumors with bulk RNA-seq and overall survival.
dataset.cohort_context: Primary grade II-III diffuse gliomas only. Recurrent tumors, grade IV tumors and patient identifiers beginning TCGA- are excluded before sample selection.
dataset.publication_citation: Varn et al. Cell 2022; Malta et al. Cancer Res 2023

metadata.curation_note: This derived release is not the complete GLASS study. Explicit TCGA identifiers, recurrent samples and grade IV tumors are excluded to create a disease-matched non-TCGA LGG cohort.

expression.label: log2(TPM + 1)
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: Repeated rows with the same supplied symbol are averaged sample-wise before log2(TPM + 1); different identifiers are never merged implicitly.
expression.scale_note: DataHub describes Kallisto TPM values. TCGA-TRACE applies the declared log2(TPM + 1) transform after cohort filtering.
